title: Vanilla Rewritten
description: A modpack that doesn't take away anything from Vanilla but adds more features for singleplayer, and also some for multiplayer.
body:
# Vanilla Rewritten

Vanilla Rewritten is a Minecraft modpack that focuses on performance while keeping the classic gameplay intact. This pack combines several optimization tools, visual improvements, and utility features to help your world run smoothly.

---

## Performance & Optimization

Enjoy a high frame rate with top optimization mods:

* **Sodium & Sodium Extra**: These mods offer significant FPS boosts and more graphical settings.
* **Lithium**: This mod optimizes game physics and logic to cut down on lag.
* **FerriteCore**: It greatly lowers memory usage.
* **ImmediatelyFast & BadOptimizations**: These mods speed up rendering and simplify background processes.
* **EntityCulling & MoreCulling**: This feature enhances performance by avoiding the rendering of hidden objects.

---

## Visual Enhancements

Improve your world’s appearance while keeping the vanilla style:

* **Iris Shaders**: Supports modern shaders with high performance.
* **Continuity**: Enables connected textures for glass and other blocks.
* **LambDynamicLights**: Adds real-time lighting effects to held torches and glowing entities, in case you don't want shaders
* **Entity Texture Features (ETF) & Entity Model Features (EMF)**: Allow for more varied and detailed mob appearances.
* **Wavey Capes & Skin Layers**: Add fluid physics to capes and create a 3D effect on player skins.
* **Serene Seasons**: Makes the game have seasons based on in-game days! It affects your crop growth, while also providing a guide on when they thrive for each season!

---

## Utility & Navigation

Easily navigate your world and manage your resources:

* **Xaero’s Minimap & World Map**: These are high-performance mapping tools for tracking your exploration.
* **Jade**: Provides on-screen tooltips for blocks and entities you are looking at.
* **AppleSkin**: Shows food values and saturation details on the hunger bar.
* **Mouse Tweaks & Smooth Scrolling**: Improve inventory interactions and menu navigation.
* **Zoomify**: A flexible zoom feature for scouting terrain.

---

## Quality of Life & Privacy

* **Panorama Screenmake**: Allows you to make your own panoramas at the press of a button.  
* **No Chat Reports**: Turns off the chat reporting system to protect player privacy.
* **Freecam**: Lets you scout areas or look at your builds from a distance.
* **Chat Heads**: Displays player heads alongside their chat messages.

---

## Versions Supported

* 1.21.11  
* 1.21.10
